name: io.github.olk/agent-pattern-mcp
title: Agent Pattern MCP
description: MCP server that provides AI agent pattern expertise for designing agent systems

runtimeArguments.name: --add-host
runtimeArguments.description: Makes a TEI embedder/reranker running on the Docker host reachable from the container (needed on Linux; already provided by Docker Desktop).

environmentVariables.name: GENERATOR_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key for the generator LLM (LiteLLM provider).

environmentVariables.name: GENERATOR_PROVIDER
environmentVariables.description: LiteLLM provider prefix, e.g. openai, anthropic, openrouter, minimax.

environmentVariables.name: GENERATOR_MODEL
environmentVariables.description: Model name, combined as <provider>/<model> via LiteLLM.

environmentVariables.name: PATTERN_DIRECTORY
environmentVariables.description: Directory with *-pattern.json files. The image bakes the 61-pattern catalog at /app/pattern.

environmentVariables.name: EMBEDDER_PROVIDER
environmentVariables.description: Embedding backend for pattern retrieval: tei, openai, ollama, vllm or hosted_vllm.

environmentVariables.name: EMBEDDER_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Embedder endpoint. For TEI sidecars on the host use http://host.docker.internal:8080/v1 (add --add-host=host.docker.internal:host-gateway on Linux).

environmentVariables.name: EMBEDDER_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key for the embedder. Required for startup even with keyless TEI; use 'not-needed' there.

environmentVariables.name: RERANKER_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: TEI cross-encoder reranker endpoint used during pattern retrieval.
